environment: Disposable restored local database with migrations 127-134 committed only on the clone; real candidate Next page, synthetic private account and encrypted synthetic messages. Clone was dropped after verification.
changes: Learning skip and candidate review show per-item success/failure details and preserve failed selections.

Candidate review selections persist across pages; batch buttons count and submit only the visible page, within the existing eight-item server limit. Other-page selections are shown and can be cleared.
Current-page select-all has an indeterminate state. On mobile, selected counts remain visible and per-item details are collapsed by default so the review list retains reading space.

verification.realApi: Ten encrypted synthetic mails were selected across 8+2 pages on desktop and mobile; the actual authorize API returned 202 and created ten consent/hash-bound queued jobs. No worker was started.
verification.interceptedPartialResponses: On the actual candidate page, one success and one failed learning-skip response, and one success and one failed candidate-review response, were injected only at the HTTP response boundary. Their details, failed selection and current-page button counts were checked. No skip or candidate-review database write occurred in these partial-response cases.
verification.candidateCrossPageSelection: Nine synthetic response-only candidates across 8+1 pages; selecting on both pages persisted. Returning to page 1 showed two current-page selections, and its partial batch left the failed item selected while the other-page item remained selected.
verification.visualInspection: 390x760 screenshot checked: no horizontal overflow; selected counts, clear control, collapsed result summary and the first candidate card are visible.

limits: Partial response tests exercise candidate-page rendering with intercepted HTTP results, not actual partial database transactions. Real mailbox synchronization, background worker outcomes, failed-item retry after a true backend failure, production loading and remaining F01-F13 entries still require separate evidence.
